com.datastax.oss.driver.api.querybuilder

Interface Literal

  • All Superinterfaces:
    CqlSnippet, Selector, Term

    public interface Literal
extends Selector, Term
    A value that will be appended as a CQL literal.

    For convenience, it can be used both as a selector and a term. The only downside is that the Selector.as(CqlIdentifier) method is only valid when used as a selector; make sure you don't use it elsewhere, or you will generate invalid CQL that will fail at execution time.
